problem: B_UPDATE_010/013/016 live: tools/coopmwm/bank_imitation.run AWR imitation of verified plan-bank pairs after PPO stops via the KL trust region (kl_limit 0.045, reference = frozen PRE-UPDATE policy) inside the FIRST pass (pairs_seen 768-1280 of 1650, epochs_completed 0 of 5); the policy never completed one pass over the bank (imitation 13 steps vs 115 PPO steps).

build.default: off (key absent/None); registered MAIN09:36 rule reproduced byte-identically when off
build.own_trust_region: bank_imitation._own_pass snapshots the policy at run() entry, which exact_update calls immediately after _ppo_exact_update, so the imitation KL anchor is the post-PPO pre-imitation policy; PPO's KL spend no longer consumes the imitation budget
build.guaranteed_first_pass: pass 1 is ordered cooperative-first (flags from the bank's confirmation cooperation record, oversampled duplicates included); instead of stopping, the per-step learning rate is halved and the rejected trial step is fully rolled back (parameters AND optimizer state) whenever the projected post-step FULL-bank KL would exceed kl_limit 0.045, so every committed step keeps KL <= limit and pass 1 always completes; additional passes beyond the first keep the same projected-KL adaptive response (statistical rule, no behavioural thresholds; kl_limit 0.045 inherited unchanged) and the registered KL early-stop remains available for them

config_keys.imitation_trust: string; set 'own_pass' to enable; absent/None = off. Flow: replay control config (v['imitation_trust']) -> replay_start.binding -> warm_runner binding b -> exact_grade.exact_update -> bank_imitation.run
config_keys.pair_flags: internal bank_pairs(root,arm,seed,...,pair_flags=False) kwarg; True adds summary['pair_cooperative'] (one bool per imitation pair, cooperative entries True including oversampled duplicates); warm_runner requests it only when imitation_trust is set

call_sites: tools/coopmwm/exact_grade.py: exact_update(..., imitation_trust=None, cooperative=None) threads to run; loss_rule string gains the own-pass clause only when on

tools/coopmwm/warm_runner.py: bank_pairs(..., pair_flags=bool(b.get('imitation_trust'))); exact_update(..., imitation_trust=b.get('imitation_trust'), cooperative=weights.get('pair_cooperative')) (replay path only)
tools/coopmwm/replay_bank.py: bank_pairs(..., pair_flags=False) emits out['pair_cooperative'] only when requested
tools/coopmwm/replay_start.py: binding() forwards v.get('imitation_trust') beside imitation_epochs
